title: kalopanax pictus var. magnificus

This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and lignans, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in pharmaceutical applications.
